independentContourProof.negativeControlScope: Missing all fill, missing first glyph, one-pixel heavier stroke, mismatched text, boolean/infinite font, wrong outline width and unbounded scalar geometry on each page, plus balanced same-component stroke redistribution.

No Swift certificate booleans trusted. This is corpus evidence, not an all-input proof or a new build. Raw metrics and historical reports are unchanged.

finalExportRasterAcceptance.authorization: The user asked not to reject insignificant pixel differences. Numeric bounds and the composed color rule are implementation choices; the user did not prescribe these thresholds.
finalExportRasterAcceptance.policy: same dimensions; RGBA channel delta <= 4 anywhere; delta <= 16 on at most 0.1% pixels over delta 4; or bounded common axis displacement <= 1 physical pixel
finalExportRasterAcceptance.retainedExactChecks: Raw exact-equality metrics, hashes and decoded diff images remain in saved reports. Cross-depth cache PNG bytes, source-erasure, source protection, layout/typography invariants, pixel-kernel gates and all other explicit exact tests remain required.
finalExportRasterAcceptance.boundaryTests: Existing low-color, dimension/malformed, material glyph and common-displacement tests remain. A fourth color-policy test adds mixed low/moderate counts, strong-count3096/3097, unchanged maximum16/17 and missing/high-contrast negatives. Strong counts must be nonnegative, <=raw changed, and consistent with maximum delta.
finalExportRasterAcceptance.doesNotClaim: The full-ios-7 result predates this helper and is not a validation run of the revised acceptance policy.

finalFixtureReport.acceptancePolicy: same dimensions; RGBA channel delta <= 4 anywhere; delta <= 16 on at most 0.1% pixels over delta 4; or bounded common axis displacement <= 1 physical pixel
finalFixtureReport.details: All raw RGBA metrics, hashes and diff images remain. Separate exact, low-delta, sparse-delta and common-displacement counters; independent PNG certificate recomputation required. All16 fixtures remain; no source/region exceptions.

finalExportRasterAcceptance.independentReportCheck: Independently decoded raw changed/max and pixels-over4 must exactly equal reported values under the new composed policy. Historical policies retain their original all-changed sparse budgets and optional fields. Existing common-displacement proof and budget are unchanged.

commonDisplacementAssessment.scope: Final export only, same positive dimensions; all changed <= floor(total/1000); one common axis coverage displacement <=1 physical pixel; opaque equal constant two-pixel border, exact global and projected per-channel mass, <=1 residual quantization level, envelope <=65536 pixels. No source, kernel, cache, or semantic exemption.
commonDisplacementAssessment.evidence: focused21 page10:1153 changed/max186; reference and actual differ by exactly one downward physical row; entering/leaving border and all column/channel mass exactly equal. Other captures and historical runtime rows are unchanged.
commonDisplacementAssessment.validation: 42/42 external Python acceptance/report controls plus static AST/JSON/no-skip and git apply --check passed; Swift tests not compiled or run at this staging snapshot. Three mandatory new Swift tests staged. Source inventory/runtime counts remain historical pending final integration.

composedColorAssessment.scope: Unrestricted delta<=4 composes with delta<=16 on at most0.1% pixels whose maximum RGBA delta exceeds4. Raw changed/max remain unchanged. Existing common-displacement proof and full-change budget are untouched.

actualFocused24.correctedPage4: Still rejected:2674raw/max255; common shape mass/border/projection fail. No threshold increase or fixture exemption.

composedColorAssessment.validation: 28/28 external PNG/report controls pass, including both actual page11 phases accepted and corrected page4 phases rejected, quota boundaries, missing/high-delta glyph, forged strong/raw/max counts, and historical policy preservation. Swift/iOS not compiled or run. Source inventory and previous runtime entries remain historical pending final verification.

depthContourSupplement.scope: Test-only supplemental gate in ReaderTranslationDepthDeviceTests.recordedPagesMatchFrozenWebRendererAcrossDepths after the base raster gate fails. The final16 suite and report.py retain their existing declared base policy and statuses.
depthContourSupplement.globalContract: Equal positive dimensions, exact alpha at every pixel, and the original whole-image count of pixels with RGBA delta >4 at most floor(totalPixels/1000), i.e. 0.1%. Every original pixel above delta16 must be covered by actual verified glyph or rounded-panel evidence. No page-ID waiver or blanket crop exemption; raw changed/max/strong counts remain unchanged.
depthContourSupplement.glyphContract: Required live text/font/line/style/paint-order and bounded scalar geometry match before known-palette projection. Both fill masks and boundaries match bidirectionally within one physical pixel; binary area and soft coverage drift are each <=1%, coverage redistribution <=10%, and connected components match one-to-one with <=1% soft-mass drift per component. Every crop pixel above delta8 must lie on the verified boundary and fit the audited palette. Missing/malformed/nonfinite or excessive geometry fails closed.
depthContourSupplement.panelContract: Matching standalone opaque rounded-panel geometry/fill, <=1/64 CSS unit placement difference and <=0.1% material-area drift. Certified residuals must be outside glyph ink, within one physical pixel of the actual rounded contour, <=delta32, and consistent with the same-fill blend direction. Other pixels retain the unchanged global quota and base color rules.
depthContourSupplement.boundedWork: Scale <=4; glyph crop <=65536 pixels and total glyph crop budget262144. No unrestricted alignment search.
depthContourSupplement.evidenceContract: Depth artifacts retain additionalAcceptanceContract, contourCertificate and the explicitly selected referenceDirectory; the independent proof is recorded in validation.independentContourProof.
depthContourSupplement.retainedMandatoryGates: Source/protected-art pixels, restoration ownership, text/layout/font assertions, native pixel kernels and cross-depth cache bytes keep their exact or separately declared assertions. A contour certificate does not mark raw pixels exact.

runtimeValidation.scope: This completed unfiltered run proves zero runtime skips for its frozen sources, but failed two tests. It predates the four newly added declarations and revised final-export acceptance. Focused runs do not replace a later complete run of final sources.
